notes.title: Soundtrack Release!!
notes.content:
The soundtrack of "MY ANIMA BOY", "KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One", is now available for purchase!


[h1]Every single piece of music from past to future KITTYPOOL productions is included![/h1]


"KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One" contains all the music used in past KITTYPOOL productions, as well as all the music that will be used in all future KITTYPOOL productions.


As new songs are added in the future, the price is expected to increase accordingly, so it's a great deal to buy early!


Here is the store page for "KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One":
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896100/KITTYPOOLs_OST_All_In_One/
